$Comment: Nice: reach Honored on Santa's Nice List, the rank the list calls Nice, and collect Santa's gift.
Earned once and kept, like On the List: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no merry tag. REPUTATION_RANK
credits every rank a player's favor has reached, each time their favor changes and when they log in.
Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey words the step with the
list's own rank name. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_nice, and its words come from the
The gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page until the player collects it: Christmas
Coins, the game's green Christmas Packet and a bundle of snowballs, and MMO Skill Tree's
Mmo_Boost_Token, a quarter more XP in every skill for an hour, which the player starts when it suits
them. The token row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without
that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest still pays. There a Hot Cocoa stands in for it, a buff the
player also starts when it suits them: that row's own Requires, the same condition with Max 0, leaves it
out where MMO Skill Tree is installed.
